subject: general
question: During the framing of the Indian Constitution, the Constituent Assembly held a total of eleven sessions, with sittings spread over for how many days?
solution:
The correct answer is __**165**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was established in **1946** to draft the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Assembly held a total of **eleven sessions** between December 1946 and January 1950.
 
• The sittings of the Constituent Assembly were spread over **165 days**, during which deliberations on various aspects of the Constitution took place.
 
• The Constituent Assembly adopted the final draft of the Constitution on **26th November 1949**, which came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the **Drafting Committee**, which played a pivotal role in framing the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly Membership:**

 
 
• The Assembly initially had **389 members**, which was later reduced to 299 after the partition of India.
 
• Members were elected indirectly by the provincial assemblies under the Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946.
 
 
 
• **Sessions of the Assembly:**
 
 
• The first session was held on **9th December 1946**, presided over by Dr. Sachidananda Sinha as the temporary chairman.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was later elected as the permanent President of the Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution is the **longest written constitution** in the world.
 
• It incorporates features of various constitutions, including parliamentary democracy, federalism, and fundamental rights.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Drafting Committee:**
 
 
• The Drafting Committee, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, was responsible for preparing the draft of the Constitution.
 
• The committee worked for **two years, eleven months, and eighteen days** to finalize the draft.
